name: That App Show

sources.title: Homepage — active software product directory; FAQ confirms 'submit your own product through the submission page, reviewed before added'
Submit route — 'Log in to Get Started. Please sign in to submit your product' (Google sign-in or account creation)

conditions: Submission requires a free account — Google sign-in or email signup via /get-started
Whether the listing itself costs money is not visible before login — no public pricing for submissions
requirements: Software products: apps, SaaS tools, digital products across ~50 categories (AI assistants, dev tools, marketing, etc.)
Account required before the submit form is shown ('Please sign in to submit your product')
Submissions are reviewed before being added to the directory
preparation: Google account or email for signup
Product name, URL, short description, pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid/Free Trial — these appear as listing badges)
Category pick from their taxonomy; a square logo/thumbnail appears on listing cards
workflow: Open https://thatappshow.com/get-started and sign in (Google or create account)
Complete the product submission form (name, URL, description, categories, pricing model)
Wait for editorial review — FAQ says submissions are reviewed before publication
Live listings appear under /explore, /latest, and the chosen /category/<slug>/ pages
watchFor: Post-login submission pricing (if any) is not publicly disclosed — check for a paywall inside
A persistent 'We Submit Your SaaS to 140+ Directories' ad (submitsaas.com) runs on the site — do not confuse the paid submission service with the directory's own free route
'Featured Products' carousel at top likely involves paid placement — standard listing is the default
countsAsLive: The product's own listing page on thatappshow.com exists and appears under /explore or /category/<slug>/ with a Visit link
unknowns: Whether a paid tier exists behind the login for submission/featured placement
